import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Clean text function
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Remove surrounding quotes and clean
    text = text.strip('"')
    # Remove extra whitespace and normalize
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    # Extract just the comment part (some have user prefixes)
    if "\\n\\n" in text:
        parts = text.split("\\n\\n")
        text = parts[-1] if len(parts) > 1 else text
    return text.strip()


# Extract temporal features
def extract_temporal_features(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == "":
        return [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]  # hour, day_of_week, day_of_month, month, year
    try:
        date_str = str(date_str).replace("Z", "")
        year = int(date_str[0:4])
        month = int(date_str[4:6])
        day = int(date_str[6:8])
        hour = int(date_str[8:10])
        minute = int(date_str[10:12])

        # Calculate day of week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday)
        from datetime import datetime

        dt = datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute)
        dow = dt.weekday()

        return [hour, dow, day, month, year]
    except:
        return [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]


# Text feature extraction
def extract_text_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        text_clean = clean_text(text)
        length = len(text_clean)
        capital_ratio = sum(1 for c in text_clean if c.isupper()) / max(length, 1)
        word_count = len(text_clean.split())
        exclamation_count = text_clean.count("!")
        question_count = text_clean.count("?")
        # Count profanity indicators (common insults)
        profanity_words = [
            "stupid",
            "idiot",
            "fag",
            "gay",
            "shit",
            "bullshit",
            "bitch",
            "dumb",
            "ugly",
            "fat",
            "worthless",
            "crap",
            "damn",
            "hell",
            "fuck",
            "fucking",
            "ass",
            "dick",
            "piss",
            "suck",
            "loser",
        ]
        profanity_count = sum(
            1 for word in profanity_words if word in text_clean.lower()
        )
        # Check for all caps words
        caps_words = sum(
            1 for word in text_clean.split() if word.isupper() and len(word) > 1
        )

        features.append(
            [
                length,
                capital_ratio,
                word_count,
                exclamation_count,
                question_count,
                profanity_count,
                caps_words,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


# Process data
print("Processing features...")
# Extract text and clean
train_df["text_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["text_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Temporal features
print("Extracting temporal features...")
train_temp = np.array([extract_temporal_features(d) for d in train_df["Date"]])
test_temp = np.array([extract_temporal_features(d) for d in test_df["Date"]])

# Text features
print("Extracting text features...")
train_text_feats = extract_text_features(train_df["Comment"].values)
test_text_feats = extract_text_features(test_df["Comment"].values)

# TF-IDF features with character n-grams
print("Building TF-IDF features...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=5000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)
tfidf_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text_clean"])
tfidf_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text_clean"])

# Combine all features
print("Combining features...")
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix

# Convert dense features to sparse
train_temp_sparse = csr_matrix(train_temp)
test_temp_sparse = csr_matrix(test_temp)
train_text_sparse = csr_matrix(train_text_feats)
test_text_sparse = csr_matrix(test_text_feats)

X_train = hstack([tfidf_train, train_temp_sparse, train_text_sparse])
X_test = hstack([tfidf_test, test_temp_sparse, test_text_sparse])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Split for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train LightGBM model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    num_boost_round=500,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on validation set and compute AUC
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Calibrate predictions for better probability estimates
print("Calibrating predictions...")
calibrated_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, method="sigmoid", cv="prefit")
calibrated_model.fit(X_val, y_val)

# Final predictions on test set
test_pred = calibrated_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission
print("Creating submission...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": test_pred})
# Match the sample submission index (id column)
if "id" in sample_sub.columns:
    submission.insert(0, "id", sample_sub["id"])
elif "Comment" in sample_sub.columns:
    # If sample submission doesn't have id, use Comment as identifier
    submission.insert(0, "Comment", sample_sub["Comment"])

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final validation AUC: {auc_score:.6f}")
